dimensions.assessment: Applies to all federal agencies issuing guidance and members of the public reading agency guidance documents.
dimensions.evidence: Each agency, as defined in section 551 of title 5, United States Code, shall include a guidance clarity statement

dimensions.assessment: Administrative requirement to add standard disclaimer text to agency guidance documents without altering underlying substantive laws.
dimensions.evidence: The contents of this document do not have the force and effect of law and do not, of themselves, bind the public or the agency.

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue effects are mentioned in the source.
Imposes a procedural documentation requirement across federal agencies for specific categories of guidance.
dimensions.evidence: shall include a guidance clarity statement... on any guidance issued by that agency

dimensions.assessment: Permanent requirement taking effect for guidance issued 30 days after OMB issues implementation guidance.
dimensions.evidence: on any guidance issued by that agency... on and after the date that is 30 days after the date on which the Director of the Office of Management and Budget issues the guidance

missing_information: Specific cost estimates for implementing the documentation changes across agencies are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies to include a standardized clarity statement on the first page of certain guidance documents.
